title: Scene: GrabMechanics doesn't seem to work
body: Machine: Windows 10 Fall Creators update, Unity: 2017.2. I tried this scene (GrabMechanics) in the editor, and compiled to debug, and in neither one can I pick up and control anything. Should this scene still work? And if not, I wonder if anybody has a quick answer why not? There isn't much in the scene to begin with!
author: erichfrazer

comments.body:
Yep, I ran this the other day to help somebody else figure it out. The problem he was running into: are you pointing at the objects to interact or actually reaching out, intersecting the blocks with your block hands, and then interacting? They were trying to point and click, but actually "grabbing" the objects is the way this sample works.

Another thing to check is to make sure you're pressing the right button. If I remember correctly, this scene works with the grasp button, not the trigger.

Let me know if it still doesn't work for you!

Oop, Grab does work, you DO have to reach out and grab it w/ the chunky block. Well, this is a relief. And yeah, I'm not used to using the Grasp button. You may close this.

One thing I can't figure out is where MotionController.cs went. I see the visualizer script file, but the MotionController base script is gone. Has this been replaced with a different set of mechanics for input control? and recently?

There's MotionControllerVisualizer and MotionControllerInfo, which contains the data about the model and animation parameters. I don't believe there's ever been a MotionController script like you describe. The controller controls are routed through InputManager events. Are you perhaps thinking of a script in the MRDL/HUX?
Ah, I tagged this as a bug cause I didn't get it to work either.  Good to hear.

I am using the Motion Controllers from Dell. I can click and change the active controll to the controller but when I focus on an object and click the Grasp button nothing happens. Do I physically need to move the controller to the object?

Sorry to say that even moving the controller to touch/pass through did  not work. I am getting the GLTF material for my controller. I move the controller into position and click/grasp the grab button on the side of the controller. nada
PS. I am running in editor viewing on HMD
I just tried to force the use of the alternate models and still no interactions.
Looks like there was a bug introduced with the prefab changes in the recent visualizer update. PR incoming with a fix.

Identification of the correct button to use for grabbing objects
Information about the current implementation of motion controller functionality
Confirmation that the scene should work as expected

title: Tagalong Script not working as intended
body:
Device: HoloLens

I have added the Tagalong script to a GameObject. It follows me, but it always stays behind me, when I walk away. How can I make it stay inside my Field of View?
author: eluchsinger

comments.body: Try the `SphereBasedTagalong` and reduce it's radius to something like 0.1 and move it out about 2 meters in front of you.

title: Stuck between master and RC Beta branch
body:
Hi, 

I'm completely clueless on how to find a way to get to work with the MRTK and Hololens.
I finally got to work my dev env ( meaning VS17 or Unity + MRTK managin both to deploy and build the app).  
BUT ! When I use the master branch with Unity 2017.1.1.f1 I'm stuck with
 ```Error! RenderTexture.GenerateMips failed: render texture does not have mip maps (set useMipMap to true).```
 that's freaking annoying because it floods my console a lot and could even lower performances.

On the other hand, with Unity 2017.2.0f1 (RC) and beta branch, I'm being told my target device ( Hololens isn't up to date) ` DEP3321: To deploy this application, your deployment target should be running Windows Universal Runtime version 10.0.16288.0 or higher. You currently are running version 10.0.14393.1715. Please update your OS, or change your deployment target to a device with the appropriate version.	GTS_Demo`
I'm already running Insider on it and it's up to date :(
(Latest SDK and insider update installed on the dev computer)


And finally, master branch MRTK with a beta Unity doesn't work, as I understand API changed a lot.

I know this is not bug related but I'm starting to loose hope on finding a stable dev environment...  Plus Unity forums and  Microsoft Hololens forums never have shown very helpful

Thanks a lot in advance !
author: drenghel

comments.body:
Hey Andre,

The generate mipmaps error is benign, you can ignore it, although like you mentioned, it fills the logs and is annoying.

The issue you are running into with 2017.2 is a pretty easy fix.  On the unity build settings window, you probably have the build target set to "latest installed" where as HoloLens is at version 15063. If you set that to match, it should solve that problem.

Holy cow, it's finally working ! thanks a lot @jessemcculloch ! 
I'm a bit confused, isn't the latest SDK (16 something) needed to run the beta MRTK ?
Yes and no. It needs to be installed for some of the API's for the Immersive Headsets and Motion Controllers to compile. But the OS on the HoloLens itself is only at 15063.

Noted !
But as I expected something else doesn't work.
I'm attempting to build&run the SpatialUnderstanding scene. But it crashed my Unity or throws an exception in VS or crashes on Hololens. Is it an known issue ? I can't get to work any spatial visualization since this morning ^^"
Did you grab the pre-release of Dev_Unity_2017.2 from the releases page, or did you just download the raw code from the branch this morning?

My bad, forgot to answer.
Yup I did :)
And there is more I never managed to get to work SpatialMapping from MRTK, even in the 'old' version.
I check `drawVisualMeshes` but never show a thing ( So I used the Unity vanilla component )
